an5.94:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these five ways of living comfortably.
an5.94:1.3: It’s when a bhikkhu, fully withdrawn from sensual pleasures, secluded from unskillful qualities, enters and dwells in the first stage of meditation, which has the delight and contentment born of seclusion, with thinking and considering.
an5.94:1.4: As thinking and considering are stilled, they enter and dwell in the second stage of meditation … third stage of meditation … fourth stage of meditation …
an5.94:1.5: They realize the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom in this very life. And they live having realized it with their own insight due to the destruction of defilements.
an5.94:1.6: These are the five ways of living comfortably.”
